title: Car Rentals - Worldwide
highlights: It is projected that the revenue in the Car Rentals market worldwide will reach US$112.00bn by 2026.
Additionally, an annual growth rate of 4.93% is expected between 2026 and 2030, resulting in a projected market volume of US$135.75bn by 2030.
Furthermore, it is anticipated that by 2030, the number of users in this market will reach 776.96m users.
The user penetration rate is expected to be 8.4% in 2026, and it is projected to increase to 9.6% by 2030.
The average revenue per user (ARPU) is expected to amount to US$168.53.
Moreover, it is projected that by 2030, 75% of the total revenue generated in the Car Rentals market will be through online sales.
It is worth noting that in global comparison, United States is expected to generate the most revenue in this market, with a projected revenue of US$34bn in 2026.
In the United States, car rental companies are adapting to the rise of ride-sharing services by offering more flexible rental options and loyalty programs.
